records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Hana,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, North Media
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks for setting up North Media on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero customer replies to three outreach emails (967ceaca, aad967bc, 46134965) plus a kickoff no-show (calendar:bdc1d190). No tickets or any sign of engagement, so unaided activation in 8 days looks unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting North Media's first project going
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Sorry we missed each other for the kickoff last week — happy to work around whatever's busiest on your end.

If it's useful, I can walk you through setting up your first real project in North Media's workspace. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the quickest way to see how it fits your team. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? Send me a couple of times that suit you.

Best,
Nadia
